storyPlan.premise: How I make a TikTok with one sentence: I type an idea, the AI agent writes 3 hooks, I pick one, it writes the script, then it draws every scene as code and checks its own frames – and I get an MP4. Show the idea flowing through each step like a pipeline, ending in a finished phone video.

plan.visualBrief: Screen recording: the one-line idea is typed into the 'Video idea' box in TikMaker, then the finished vertical MP4 plays inside a phone block right next to it.

scenes.vo: I typed this one sentence. It came back as a finished TikTok.

plan.visualBrief: A horizontal pipeline draws itself across the screen: five connected stations labelled Idea, Hooks, Script, Scenes, MP4, with an empty phone at the far end.

scenes.vo: Here's the whole pipeline, from one sentence to a video you can post.

plan.visualBrief: The pipeline slides into a panel labelled 'TikMaker AI agent', which lights up as the engine driving every station.

scenes.vo: It all runs inside TikMaker's AI agent.

plan.visualBrief: A single line of text drops into the first station of the pipeline, a 'Start' button is pressed, and the sentence starts flowing down the pipe.

scenes.vo: First, I type the idea and hit Start.

plan.visualBrief: Screen recording: in the agent panel the progress bar ticks to the next step and a card with three hooks appears; the cursor clicks one of them.

scenes.vo: Second, the agent writes three hooks, each with what it shows. I pick one.

plan.visualBrief: Screen recording: the script card lists each scene's voiceover and on-screen words; the cursor scrolls through and clicks 'Approve'.

scenes.vo: Third, it writes the script scene by scene. I read it and hit Approve.

plan.visualBrief: At the Scenes station, lines of code turn into vertical frames one by one, and a checkmark stamps onto each frame as it passes inspection.

scenes.vo: Then it draws every scene as code and checks its own frames.

richHeadline.text: 4. Scenes drawn as code + frames checked

plan.visualBrief: Screen recording: the scene strip and timeline fill with the video's scenes, the cursor clicks 'Render MP4' top right, a progress bar runs, then the finished MP4 file appears to download.

scenes.vo: The scenes fill the timeline, I hit Render MP4, and the file is ready to download.

plan.visualBrief: The MP4 shoots out the end of the pipeline into the phone, which starts playing the finished vertical video with its kinetic captions.

scenes.vo: One sentence in. A finished TikTok out.
